newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico June industrial activity up 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico June industrial activity up 9.9 pct.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry released the following data on industrial production for June:
The figure was higher than an 8.3 percent average forecast in a Reuters survey of 13 economists.

The Finance Ministry said second-quarter industrial activity rose 11.2 percent compared to the same quarter last year. On Tuesday, the Finance Ministry releases second-quarter Gross Domestic Product data, and the higher-than-expected June industrial activity figure may boost some GDP forecasts.

Compared with the first six months of 1996, manufacturing was up 9.1 percent between January and June, construction rose 10.2 percent, generation of electricity, gas and water rose 5.2 percent and mining output was up 3.6 percent.

In June alone, manufacturing rose 11.3 percent. In the first six months, non-maquiladora manufacturing firms increased production by 8.8 percent, while maquiladora firms stepped up output by 13.7 percent.
Construction activity rose 7 percent in June, electricity, gas and water generation was up 4.3 percent in June and mining was up 5.6 percent compared with June 1996.
